summary: No thesis broke on the news today. None of the nine holdings (CARG, DPZ, IDXX, INCY, KR, MSCI, SAM, TLT, VRSN) has an 8-K, 10-Q or 10-K in the 7-day window except SAM's 11-19 8-K 5.02. No stop_alerts fired, and no headline meets a stored clause: no guidance cut, no failed pivotal trial, no confirmed KR cyber link and no 4.01 or 4.02. Equity rose to $615.73 (+$3.88) while SPY's value fell. The day's largest moves, INCY +5.3%, KR +4.4% and IDXX +3.6%, have no headline in my input, so I can't explain them from the news. For held names the tape was quiet. The only DPZ items were sentiment: BNP's Underperform initiation with a $295 PT, which DPZ shrugged off at +0.36%, and a 'Group CMO' appointment that I read as mis-tagged. On L2: I checked every held name's own earnings estimate and 7-day filings. None reports within 5 trading days, but KR's company-confirmed 12-03 call enters that window tomorrow, 11-25. BBY's 11-24 estimate was confirmed by an 8-K 2.02 and a results headline. ADSK's 11-24 estimate is still unconfirmed in the input, with no 8-K 2.02.

DPZ closed +0.36% at $356.52, 9.7% above the re-anchored $325 stop. The 'Domino's Pizza Appoints New Group Chief Marketing Officer' item (Lara Thom, ex-Guzman y Gomez, sourced from an Australian outlet) is very likely Domino's Pizza Enterprises, the separately listed Australian master franchisee, mis-tagged to DPZ. That is an inference. Either way there is no DPZ 8-K 5.02, so it is not an executive change at DPZ Inc. Next 2027-02-22 (file estimate).

It ages out of the 7-day window after about 11-26, which would close it by expiry. SAM is 5.3% above its $201 stop, the closest in the book. No 2.02 or 7.01 guidance cut.
